newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues new rules on fixed asset investment.
newsitem.headline: China issues new rules on fixed asset investment.

text.p: China has released new rules on fixed asset investment, forbidding projects to start before investment funds are obtained, but also relaxing the definition of assets that can be included, the Shanghai Securities News said on Sunday.
The newspaper said that assets included in projects for the purpose of determining equity share could include not only cash but also physical goods, land use rights and other items.
The new regulations recently issued by the State Council, China's cabinet, were partly aimed at increasing investment in less developed parts of the country, the newspaper said.

Another regulation issued by the State Council recently said the approval process for foreign investment in inland provinces was being relaxed in order to help reduce the gap in economic development with the coastal provinces.
The Securities News said less stringent approval rules would in future apply to projects valued at up to $30 million, up from $10 million previously.
